qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow (SRF) – Ayurveda: Essential: BAMS from a recognized University/Institution. Desirable: Post-graduate degree (MD/MS in Ayurveda), prior research experience in integrative clinical trials. Project Nurse-III: Essential: Four year nursing course from a recognized institute or MSc Nursing from a recognized university with valid registration with any state nursing council. Desirable: Experience in handling clinical trial patients, blood sampling, and drug administration. Project Technical Support- III: Essential: Three years graduate in relevant subject/field + three years post qualification experience or PG in relevant subject/field. Desirable: PG in sociology or social work. Project Technical Support- I (Lab technician): Essential: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + two years experience in lab work or Three years graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience. Desirable: Experience of biological sample collection, processing, storage and cold-chain maintenance.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Project Posts at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance for registration.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Project Posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for various Research Project Posts at AIIMS Jodhpur. These include positions like Senior Research Fellow, Project Nurse, and Project Technical Support.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from BAMS, MSc Nursing, Graduate in a relevant subject, to Diploma in MLT/DMLT. Please refer to the detailed vacancy section for specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Jodhpur Research Project Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Research Project Posts at AIIMS Jodhpur is 35 years. Age relaxation details, if any, are usually mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for these contractual positions ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, plus admissible HRA, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview. A Screening/Scrutiny Test may also be conducted if deemed necessary by the authorities.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the AIIMS Jodhpur office. The specific address and reporting time are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these are contractual Research Project Posts. The job type is explicitly mentioned as Contractual in the recruitment details.
